## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The missing-results fallback must be fixed before merge: with it, `release_allowed` returns `True` when the results file does not exist, so the release gate opens with no checks recorded.

## Changes
The pull request makes `load_results` return an empty list when the results file is missing and adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when the preferences file is absent. It also adds an unused `REVIEW_NOTE` constant and a new test file covering the release gate with saved results and both preferences paths.

## Critical
- app/results.py:7 — silent-failure — Fail the release gate when the results file is missing — A nonexistent results path makes `load_results` return `[]`, so `release_allowed` at `app/results.py:12` evaluates `all([])` and returns `True`. Before this change the same input raised `FileNotFoundError`; the fallback has no log, caller signal or explaining comment. — A mistyped path or a check run that never wrote its results silently permits a release with no checks passed. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results` (or return `False` from `release_allowed` for a missing file) and extend `tests/test_results.py` with a missing-file case.
